rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: APK Security Guard MCP Suite by cc-apk provides AI assistants with comprehensive Android APK security analysis capabilities through four integrated tools: JADX for decompilation and source code analysis, MobSF for automated security scanning and vulnerability detection, JEB Pro for advanced reverse engineering with method/class analysis and cross-reference tracking, and APKTOOL for APK manipulation and resource extraction. The implementation uses a multi-language architecture with Java plugins for JADX integration, TypeScript for MobSF API communication, Python for JEB Pro JSON-RPC bridging, and cross-validation capabilities that combine results from multiple analysis engines. Designed for security researchers, malware analysts, and mobile app developers who need programmatic access to professional-grade APK analysis tools for vulnerability assessment, reverse engineering workflows, and automated security testing pipelines.
